name: Daniel
summary: Daniel was a young man of Judah taken to Babylon, where God gave him understanding of visions and dreams. He served kings faithfully, kept praying to his God, and was kept safe in the lions' den.

key_moments.title: Faithful at the King's Table
key_moments.description: Daniel resolved not to make himself unclean with the king's food and wine, and asked that he and his friends be tested for ten days on vegetables and water. At the end they looked healthier than all the others, and God gave the four of them knowledge and wisdom.

key_moments.title: The King's Dream Revealed
key_moments.description: When King Nebuchadnezzar demanded to know his dream, Daniel and his friends asked the God of heaven for mercy. God showed Daniel the secret in a vision at night, and the king set him over the province of Babylon.

key_moments.title: The Writing on the Wall
key_moments.description: Daniel was brought before King Belshazzar to read the writing on the wall. He said God had numbered the king's kingdom and found him wanting, and that night Belshazzar was slain.

key_moments.title: In the Den of Lions
key_moments.description: Daniel kept praying three times daily with his windows open toward Jerusalem, even after the king's decree. He was thrown into the lions' den, but God sent His angel to close the lions' mouths.

key_moments.title: Four Great Beasts
key_moments.description: In Belshazzar's first year Daniel dreamed and wrote down what he saw. The four winds stirred up the great sea, and four huge beasts rose out of it, each different from the others.
